name: cognis-bank-workspace
description: One-command launchers for the Cognis Bank MVP (frontend + FastAPI backend) and the optional voice CRM prototype.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm run api"
scripts.dev:voice: concurrently -k -n web,api,voice-api,voice-ui -c cyan,green,yellow,magenta "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm run api" "npm --prefix aivoiceassistance run server" "npm --prefix aivoiceassistance run client"
scripts.voice: concurrently -k -n voice-api,voice-ui -c yellow,magenta "npm --prefix aivoiceassistance run server" "npm --prefix aivoiceassistance run client"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix aivoiceassistance/server install && npm --prefix aivoiceassistance/client install
